title: Concentration on small influential sets
statement: Let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$, let $\varepsilon>0$, and let $k$ be a nonnegative integer. Suppose the total influence $I(f)$ is positive and the total squared Fourier coefficient mass on subsets of size greater than $k$ is at most $\varepsilon$. Set $\tau=\dfrac{\varepsilon^2}{I(f)^2}\left(\dfrac{1}{9}\right)^k$, and let $J$ consist of the coordinates whose Boolean influence is at least $\tau$. The total squared Fourier coefficient mass outside the family of subsets of $J$ having size at most $k$ is at most $2\varepsilon$.
